items.raw_excerpt: Kym Files fears when hearing aid services are drastically cut in his remote city, he may be left weeks or even months in silence waiting for repairs.
items.summary_en: People in remote Australian cities rely on hearing aid services that are now being drastically reduced. Users say they may face weeks or months without working devices while waiting for repairs. The cuts could leave elderly and vulnerable people isolated from their communities.

items.raw_excerpt: Uma cidade verdadeiramente sustentável não é aquela que protege seus parques fechando seus portões, mas aquela que cria condições para que eles permaneçam vivos, seguros, ambientalmente equilibrados e acessíveis a todos

items.raw_excerpt: A psychologist specialising in gambling addiction has warned that Iceland could see a significant increase in gambling-related problems in the coming years.
